markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (74%)** · Unreliable input · Defer to expert
Tier-3 flag for low reliability [F6], Benign vs InSitu ambiguity [F1], and zero neighbor agreement [F5].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Benign 74%, InSitu 23%, Normal 3%, Invasive 1% | Favors Benign; InSitu remains plausible |
| Conformal set | Benign, InSitu (90% target; 90% test coverage) | Cannot separate Benign from InSitu |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.30 reliability (flagged); 100th percentile OOD (AUROC 0.70) | Suspect, out-of-distribution input image |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | False | Independent foundation models disagree |
| Similar cases | 0/5 Benign (4 InSitu, 1 Invasive; 82%–84% similarity) | Retrieved neighbors contradict Benign call |

## Tissue evidence
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (regions 2, 4, 5) · context · Above-typical score (1.40) with negative invasive weight (-0.96) [F2] · Weak
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (region 7) · ↑ invasive · Below-typical score (0.14) nudges toward invasive (+0.35) [F3] · Validated
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 4, 8) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score (1.02) pushes away from invasive (-0.23) [F4] · Weak
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 0, 5) · ↑ invasive · Positive weight (+0.20), but 0/20 AI spot check · Unreliable
- **Neoplastic nuclei fraction / density** (regions 4, 5, 6) · context · 92% tumor nuclei (100th percentile) [F7]; 4427/mm² (99th percentile) [F8] · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; removing top 3 risk regions drops invasive score above random (+0.0114, 95% CI 0.0021–0.0197).
- **Concepts**: Unproven classifier faithfulness (+0.0008 vs random, CI -0.0088–0.0064); mitoses (0/20), normal lobules (0/20), necrosis (3/20) are Unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- High neoplastic counts (regions 4–6), 57% region-6 risk, and 4/5 InSitu neighbors reflect in situ or invasive carcinoma.
- Out-of-distribution quality (100th percentile, 10/12 regions kept) or 3% benign epithelium [F10] distorts the read.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 6, 4, 5**: Highest risk (57% in 6) and 161–230 neoplastic nuclei; check for in situ or invasion.
2. **Regions 1, 4, 8**: Evaluate ductal atypia versus hyperplasia; consider drafted deeper levels and CK5/6, ER stains.
3. **Regions 0, 7, 3, 11**: Check invasion cues (0, 7) and excluded regions (3, 11); consider drafted recut H&E.
